payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops enumerate all possible counts (i, j) of length-p and length-q pieces that sum to n; the first valid (i, j) yields the answer.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively checks all (i, j) pairs, which is a complete search over the integer solution space. Among the provided subtypes, backtracking is the closest match for this enumeration, though no recursion or pruning is used.
